question: Can the 10 annual-report duplicate rows be adjudicated by original quarterly Q4 FY table header, while sealing row/table hashes for all 32 previously accepted numeric events without changing them?

fixed_table_rule.document: Original EX-99.2 DOCUMENT/TEXT only; original raw SHA must match v1.
fixed_table_rule.quarterly_table: Among Revenue by Market Platform tables with exact Datacenter/Data Center row, choose the unique table whose text before that row includes both Q4 FY current and Q3 FY prior-quarter headers. Exclude annual FY-only table even if its row has the same name.
fixed_table_rule.units: Require $ in millions; parse first three numeric cells current/prior-quarter/prior-year and compare the final printed YoY within1.5 percentage points.
fixed_table_rule.row_hash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON of exact parsed row cells, ensure_ascii=false and compact separators.
fixed_table_rule.table_hash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 BeautifulSoup canonical HTML serialization of the selected enclosing table; raw original source SHA also retained.
fixed_table_rule.v1_invariant: For 32 previously accepted events, reparse same unique table and require exact original row cells, current/prior-quarter/prior-year/YoY/filing/effective date unchanged, then add only row/table hashes.
fixed_table_rule.unknown: Keep the 21 v1 no-row events unknown without opening their originals or carrying older values past them.

stop: Stop or retain each unresolved Q4 as unknown if exact Q4/Q3 unique table or YoY/unit check fails; never use SOXX outcomes or annual table as quarterly value. Any v1 accepted-value mismatch stops whole repair. Source remains first-public/definition unqualified until separate review.
